description.value: Lynn Creek Community Recreation Centre is a municipal facility operated by North Vancouver Recreation and Culture, serving both the City and District of North Vancouver. The centre features a full gymnasium with an official-size volleyball or basketball court, fitness studios with TRX training anchors, and several multi-purpose rooms including a makerspace. It sits on Hunter Street in the Lynn Creek neighbourhood, a short distance from the popular Lynn Valley trail network.
